detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Trail & Error is a chaotic co-op survival game for 1–4 players where poor decisions, bad luck, and questionable teamwork are just as dangerous as the trail itself.

Travel together across an unknown frontier, manage limited supplies, survive unpredictable disasters, and try not to abandon your friends when things go wrong. The goal is simple: reach the end of the trail alive.

Survive the Trail (Together… or Not)

Every run is a shared journey filled with dynamic events, environmental hazards, and tough choices. Food runs out. Illness spreads. Weather turns hostile. Your wagon breaks at the worst possible time.

When disaster strikes, you’ll have to adapt on the fly or deal with the consequences.

Physics-Based Chaos

Movement and interaction are driven by physics, turning everyday tasks into unpredictable problems:

  • Haul supplies and manage a physics-driven wagon

  • Navigate rough terrain and environmental hazards

  • Watch plans fall apart in the funniest ways possible

The physics won’t always kill you, but it will make things complicated.

Talk It Out (or Yell About It)

With proximity voice chat, coordination matters especially when things start going wrong. Expect frantic callouts, bad ideas, and arguments that feel all too familiar.

Key Features

  • 1–4 player online co-op

  • Physics-based wagon and character movement

  • Randomized events and dynamic weather

  • 4 Different map biomes

  • Survival based mechanics

  • Resource management: food, health, and illness

  • Proximity voice chat for immersive (and chaotic) communication

Trail & Error is about teamwork, survival, and the comedy that comes from everything going wrong at exactly the wrong time.
